page: Microsoft Azure E2s_v7 is an entry-level memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features two vCPUs across a single dedicated physical core with two execution threads, running on an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with a 4.2 GHz clock speed and an x86_64 architecture. The CPU subsystem includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 480 MB L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector and matrix acceleration instructions including AVX-512, AMX-TILE, and AMX-INT8, along with hardware-assisted cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The VM is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio aligned with standard memory-optimized profiles. It lacks bundled local storage and GPUs, requiring remote storage volumes such as Azure Premium Storage for data persistence. In synthetic workloads, the instance achieves top-decile single-core throughput, reflected in a Geekbench single-core score of 2222.0 and high single-threaded decompression rates with bzip3 and gzip. Multi-threaded benchmark scores—such as a multi-core Geekbench score of 2827.0 and stress-ng multi-core metric of 2201.38—are constrained by the two-vCPU allocation.

Memory bandwidth tests show 22.5 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 11.72 GB/sec for writes, while PassMark memory performance places in the middle quartile. Text processing performance is robust, but database operations and static web serving throughput (4.81 GB/sec) reflect the hardware bounds of a dual-vCPU ceiling. As a result, the E2s_v7 provides balanced resource efficiency for memory-dependent tasks that require modest overall compute capacity, serving as a functional host for small-scale caching layers, light Redis deployments, staging databases, and entry-level enterprise application tiers.
description: Microsoft Azure E2s_v7 is an entry-level memory-optimized instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core on an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with Hyper-V virtualization, the instance includes 16.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU) and a 480 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX-512 and AMX instructions. It carries no local ephemeral storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached Premium Storage. Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-core performance, though multi-threaded scores and uncached memory bandwidth reflect the constraints of its two-thread design. With its balanced single-thread capability and generous memory-to-core ratio, the E2s_v7 is well suited for running lightweight database servers, small-footprint in-memory caches, background batch processing, and low-concurrency enterprise services.
